name: Apprentice Wizard

source.note: The apprentice wizard of Volo's Guide to Monsters (2016) in the 2024 layout, for Victor Vallakovich; the 2024 books have no such block (their Mage Apprentice is CR 2). Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Fire Bolt runs as an attack; the two 1st-level slots are listed as one use a day of each spell.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.summary: Stabs with a dagger, or throws it up to 60 ft.
actions.text: Melee or ranged attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.summary: Casts Fire Bolt up to 120 ft; loose flammable objects catch alight.
actions.text: Ranged spell attack: +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) Fire damage. A flammable object that nobody is wearing or carrying catches fire.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: A 1st-level wizard (Int, DC 12): Mending, Prestidigitation; Burning Hands, Disguise Self or Shield.
actions.text: The apprentice casts spells as a 1st-level wizard, using Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Cantrips (at will): Fire Bolt, Mending, Prestidigitation. 1st level (2 slots): Burning Hands, Disguise Self, Shield.

summary: A novice wizard who throws Fire Bolts from the back and only draws a dagger when cornered.
